decisions.reason: A hearty bread close to the core assortment costs little to keep on existing lines, and one year of website presence is too little evidence to judge its value, so the option stays open.
The mill tour uses the firm's existing heritage and event facilities at low marginal cost, and its demand is still uncertain, so keeping it preserves upside for the hospitality business.
A sweet pastry that fits the established range is cheap to sustain, and there is no negative signal yet, so it is too early to abandon it.
